_about: Hand-kept parts of the Huinsight design system that the stylesheet cannot say. Values come from the stylesheet; this file adds names, usage notes and the type scale. build.mjs warns when a variable has no note here, and when a note names a variable the stylesheet no longer defines.
name: Huinsight

usage.color-primary: Brand blue, identical in Day and Night. Primary buttons, links, active nav, the brand-mark tile, focus accents. White text on it is 3.7:1 — fine for the bold 11px+ button labels the product uses only as large/bold UI; prefer it for fills and icons over body text.
usage.color-primary-hover: Hover state of color-primary fills and link hover.
usage.brand-spark: Gold accent of the brand mark's six iris facets. Mark-only; never a UI state colour.
usage.brand-mark-hole: Pupil of the brand mark. Must equal the surface the mark sits on (it reads as a hole punched through the iris); defaults to the color-primary tile.
usage.color-investment: Indigo for investment-category data (flows, invested amounts) in charts and tags.
usage.color-success: Positive P&L, healthy status dots, ok source chips. A fill/indicator colour — for text on soft fills use zone-green-fg.
usage.color-warning: Review/caution status dots and drift within tolerance. Indicator only — text on fills uses zone-yellow-fg.
usage.color-danger: Negative P&L, errors, high severity, destructive buttons (white label). Text on soft fills uses zone-red-fg.
usage.color-card: Card, KPI tile, table and modal surfaces.
usage.color-surface: Raised/hover surface inside cards (Night: one step above card).
usage.color-border: 1px borders on cards, inputs, buttons; table header rule.
usage.color-border-soft: Row dividers, modal header/footer rules, toolbar and gauge track fills.
usage.color-fg-1: Headings, KPI values, input text — on color-bg, color-card, color-surface.
usage.color-fg-2: Body copy and table cells on color-card and color-bg.
usage.color-fg-3: Secondary text, eyebrows, neutral pill text, section icons on color-card (4.8:1 Day).
usage.color-fg-4: Muted text: table headers, axis ticks, sub-labels, placeholder icons. Below 4.5:1 on card in both themes (source value kept) — use for non-essential labels only.
usage.color-fg-5: Hairlines and disabled glyphs; never text.
usage.fill-primary-soft: Soft blue fill: primary pill/badge, selected table row, active nav item.
usage.zone-green-fg: Text on fill-success-soft; Night positive P&L text.
usage.zone-orange-fg: Text on an orange zone soft fill.
usage.zone-red-fg: Text on fill-danger-soft; Night negative P&L text.
usage.chart-1: Dashboard chart series 1 — net-worth line and area, MiniLine stroke.
usage.space-10: Large vertical breaks between page bands.
usage.radius-xl: Cards, KPI tiles, modals — the default container radius.

styles.name: uis-h3
styles.usage: Section and card headings (fs-h3); SectionTitle, ModalShell title. color-fg-1.

styles.name: uis-base
